definitions.explanation: Something that should definitely be read. Used to recommend books, articles, or other texts as essential or highly worthwhile.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{本|ほん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{必読|ひつどく}だ。

⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{興味|きょうみ}→興味：01316_kyoumi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{必読|ひつどく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一冊|いっさつ}→一冊：23149_issatsu⟧です。
examples.english: It's a must-read for anyone interested in Japanese history.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新入|しんにゅう}{社員|しゃいん}→新入社員：15536_shinnyuushain⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦まず→まず：00796_mazu⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{社内|しゃない}→社内：13731_shanai⟧⟦マニュアル→マニュアル：26993_manyuaru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{必読|ひつどく}{書|しょ}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{配|くば}っている→配る：03921_kubaru⟧。
examples.english: We distribute this internal manual to new employees as required reading.

notes:
Combines {必|ひつ} (must/necessarily) and {読|どく} (read), literally meaning "must read." Functions primarily as a noun modifier, often appearing before ⟦{書|しょ}→〜書：28467_sho⟧ (book) or {本|ほん}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {必読|ひつどく}{書|しょ}: must-read book
- {必読|ひつどく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一冊|いっさつ}→一冊：23149_issatsu⟧: a must-read volume
- {必読|ひつどく}⟦{文献|ぶんけん}→文献：12885_bunken⟧: required reading (academic)
- {必読|ひつどく}⟦リスト→リスト：09786_risuto⟧: required reading list

COMPOUNDS:
The {必|ひつ}〜 pattern appears in many similar compounds meaning "must-X":
- {必見|ひっけん}: must-see
- ⟦{必修|ひっしゅう}→必修：08641_hisshuu⟧: required (course/subject)
- {必携|ひっけい}: must-have; indispensable

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{推薦|すいせん}→推薦：03358_suisen⟧⟦{図書|としょ}→図書：03459_tosho⟧: recommended book — a suggestion rather than a strong imperative
- ⟦{課題|かだい}→課題：00132_kadai⟧⟦{図書|としょ}→図書：03459_tosho⟧: assigned reading — specifically assigned by a teacher or institution, not a general recommendation
